nom: Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester CCC+ Ferulic Brightening Complex 20%

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin reports her skin becomes even oilier and feels thick after applying this serum, especially layered with the brand's brightening sunscreen, though she still noticed brighter skin when using it; she suggests it may suit dry to normal skin better.
segments.dry: One reviewer in her 50s describes her skin as normal to dry and acne-prone and calls this the best vitamin C serum she has tried after two months of use, pairing it with a hyaluronic acid serum on drier days.
segments.normal: The same reviewer, who describes her skin as normal to dry and acne-prone, reports it has never looked better after two months of consistent use.
segments.mature: One 60-year-old reviewer with fair, heavily sun-exposed skin reports this worked faster than previous dark-spot products, calling it the best skin product she has ever used.

concerns.aging: A couple of reviewers report visibly softened fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes and forehead within two to three weeks, alongside firmer, glowing skin.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports the serum does not dry out her skin despite containing multiple forms of vitamin C, while another who had an adverse reaction separately reports her face became dry and irritated.
concerns.redness: The same reviewers who report burns, rashes, or allergic reactions (see barrier) also describe redness and itching; several other, longer-term users report brighter, more even skin with no redness issues at all.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers report serious adverse reactions: one developed second-degree burns and swelling concentrated around her eyes and mouth that took days to heal, even though she does not consider her skin sensitive and patch-tested fine elsewhere on her body; others report swollen eyelids, facial dryness and irritation, rashes, or itching and redness within days of starting use. Other reviewers, however, report no irritation at all.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report visibly lightened dark spots, sun damage and discoloration, in some cases within one to six weeks, with several calling it the most effective vitamin C serum they have tried for this purpose.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports the serum makes her skin feel oilier and thicker, especially layered under the brand's sunscreen.

aspects.libelle: Pills badly when layered under sunscreen
Priced notably higher at Ulta than buying direct

extraits.titre: Removed Dark Spots AND MY SKIN!!!!!!!
extraits.texte: I had some sort of allergic reaction to at least one of the ingredients in this product. I do not have sensitive skin. I have and continue to use many Perricone products,which I generally love. This product however caused me to have 2nd degree burns and swelling over my face..with a concentration of the burns around my eyes and mouth. I've been using only coconut oil on my face for the last 5 days, while it is healing. My face is sort of like one big scab!! This stuff took off at least a layer of my skin. I patch tested it later on my neck, behind my ears and my arms, but had no reaction. I do layer my products and was hoping that maybe this just reacted to one of the other products. However, today, stupidly, mostly because I wanted to love this product, I put a small amount on my face, in front of my ear over a dark spot. In about an hour,I developed stinging and redness in this area, but it also spread closer to my under eye, which is not where I put the cream. I am not allergic to vitamin C or ferulic acid,because I've been using Skin Ceuticals for over a year now...I waited forever to try this product...and bought it last week with the 50% off skincare sale. I am over 60 and have been using skincare since college. I have used a zillion products over the years and there's only one other time this happened to me. It was with Derma Doctors Kaduka Plum vitamin C serum. After comparing ingredients, I see they both use the same form of vitamin C- 3-O-Ethyl Ascorbic Acid. Skin C
Couldn't use this because my eyelids became so swollen and my whole face became dry and irritated.

extraits.titre: Not suited for Oily Skin, but works.
extraits.texte: I have oily skin, and my skin gets oiler once I apply the serum, even oiler when I follow up with their brightening sunscreen. My face just felt so thick and oily, if that makes sense. However, I did notice that my skin was brighter when I used the product vs when I discontinued the product. Might work well for people with dry to normal skin. :)

I've been using this serum for about 6 weeks now and I am really impressed by how much this has lightned the dark spots and discoloration on my face. I haven't had any irritation with this product at all and it doesn't have a bad smell like most products with ferulic acid. My only complaint is that this serum will pill with other products. I tend to only use sunscreen on top of this and even then it can pill up. I have found that if I mix a few drops of the pycnogenol serum from the Ordinary in with this it does help keep it from pilling. Overall, I am very pleased with how well this actually works. My skin looks amazing. My complexion is much brighter and even. I just think for the price, there shouldn't be any issues with the formula.

Fair skin. Tons of sun. It's showing. I'm 60. Tried other dark spot products with ok results. Kinda worked within a few weeks but hit a wall. This has almost wiped them out and fast, and omg, GLOWING, FIRM skin! Best skin product I've ever used!

extraits.titre: Best Vitamin C Serum Out There
extraits.texte: Where to start with the Pros of this serum!! Yes, it's pricey - but you do get 2 oz. I have tried THEM ALL. I will look no further. After 2 mos use, my 51 normal/dry PLUS acne prone skin has never looked better. Please note: this is a serum with actives - on dryer days I combine with a Hyluronic acid serum. Highly recommend!

I am in love with the Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester CCC+ Ferulic Brightening Complex 20% Serum. In the two and half weeks that I have been using this serum my skin has completely changed. It is brighter and it has a glow to it that I noticed within just 3 days of use twice daily. After the past two weeks my skin has begun to truly improve, the lines and wrinkles around my eyes and on my forehead have completely softened and in all honesty around my my eyes my wrinkles are not even noticeable. I love the Original Perricone MD Vitamin C Ester but this one with the CCC Ferulic Brightening Complex 20% serum is even better because it goes to work so quickly with real results. My skin had no bad reaction and I am going to continue to use it and will be repurchasing. Thanks for the complimentary sample.

reserve: With only 26 of 29 reviews available and several describing severe adverse reactions, this small sample makes it hard to know how representative the serious-reaction reports are of the wider user base.
